description: Checks an employer against seven questions under the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 — constitution of the Internal Committee in writing, its composition, a committee at every office, training, display, and annual reporting — and lists each gap with the provision concerned and the penalty provision. Use when an employer asks whether its POSH compliance is in order.

annual_report.description: For the last completed CALENDAR year, has the Committee prepared its annual report and has the employer made its disclosure? "both_done", "one_or_neither", or "financial_year_basis" (reports are made on the financial year)

committee_at_every_unit.description: If you have offices or administrative units at more than one place, is there a Committee at each of them? Answer true if there is only one office.

constituted_in_writing.description: Has an Internal Committee been constituted by an order in writing?

display.description: Are the penal consequences of sexual harassment and the order constituting the Committee displayed at a conspicuous place in the workplace?

four_member_committee.description: Does the Committee have at least four members — a woman Presiding Officer employed at a senior level, not less than two members from amongst the employees, and the external member?

headcount.description: How many workers are engaged at your largest workplace? "under_10" = fewer than 10; "10_or_more" = 10 or more

training.description: In the last twelve months, have you run BOTH employee workshops AND a separate orientation for Internal Committee members? "both", "staff_only" (employee workshops only) or "neither"

name: posh_compliance_check
title: POSH compliance health check
